faqs.question: What does Satva Solutions specialize in?
faqs.answer: Satva Solutions specializes in accounting integrations, ERP integrations, finance automation, SaaS product development, reporting dashboards, and custom business system integrations.

faqs.question: Which accounting and ERP systems can Satva Solutions integrate?
faqs.answer: QuickBooks, Xero, MYOB, FreshBooks, Zoho Books, SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Sage, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Odoo, and Acumatica.

faqs.question: Can Satva Solutions help SaaS companies build accounting integrations?
faqs.answer: Yes. We help SaaS companies build accounting and ERP integrations including API integration, authentication, data mapping, bi-directional sync, and marketplace launch support.

faqs.question: What business processes can Satva Solutions automate?
faqs.answer: Invoice processing, AP, AR, bank reconciliation, order sync, inventory updates, payment matching, payroll journal posting, and financial reporting.

faqs.question: Does Satva Solutions build financial reporting dashboards?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dashboards connecting accounting, ERP, CRM, payroll, eCommerce, and inventory systems with cash flow, revenue, and KPI views.

faqs.question: Does Satva Solutions offer IT staff augmentation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Developers, integration specialists, QA engineers, AI/ML engineers, and product engineers with finance-domain expertise.
